summary: Updates the Kerberos public-key initial authentication standard in RFC 4556 so it is no longer tied to specific cryptographic algorithms. The key derivation function becomes negotiable, and the digest algorithms for signing and for client certificates become discoverable. This allows newer algorithms to be rolled out gradually if old ones are found weak.

eli5.summary: Imagine a game that only works with one kind of lock. This change lets players agree on which lock to use, so a better lock can be swapped in if the old one breaks.

questions: how to change kerberos crypto algorithms
